_note: Current-law regional transmission portfolios approved by 2025, by region and in-service year, in $ billion (nominal as published). grid.py converts dollars to transmission project-equivalents at the average cost of a MISO LRTP Tranche 1 project ($10.3B / 18 = $0.572B) and gives each the model's hosting room per transmission project (tx_hosting_gw). Built 2026-11-24 by hand from the documents below; see data/SOURCES.md.

portfolios.name: LRTP Tranche 1
portfolios.source: MISO MTEP25 Chapter 2 (approved July 2022, $10.3B, 18 projects); in-service 2028-2030 per MISO portfolio materials, spread evenly [A]; MISO projects about 53 GW of generation enabled

portfolios.name: LRTP Tranche 2.1
portfolios.source: MISO MTEP25 Chapter 2, Table 2.1 (24 projects, targeted in-service year and cost per project, $M 2024)

portfolios.name: 2025 ITP (approved portfolio)
portfolios.source: SPP 2025 ITP fact sheet ($8.6B approved, 50 projects, 949 miles of new 765 kV); in-service 2030-2032 spread evenly [A]

portfolios.name: 2025 RTEP Window 1, 500 kV and above
portfolios.source: PJM 2025 RTEP report, Section 3 ($10.9B competitive baseline approved; 500 kV-and-above upgrades $9.8B; listed in-service dates 6/1/2029-6/1/2032); spread 2030-2032 evenly [A]
